items.title: The Libra Rising Birth Chart of the United States
items.summary:
In this major new episode, I do a deep dive into the historical evidence for when the Declaration of Independence was finalized on July 4, 1776. There has been a mystery surrounding the birth chart of the United States for more than two centuries, but I recently discovered some new evidence that allows us to triangulate the approximate birth time much more closely than I previously thought possible.

This was a massive research project that I suddenly stumbled into last month shortly after the Mars-Uranus conjunction went exact on July 4. I found new historical evidence showing that Thomas Jefferson regularly recorded the times he took temperature readings outside. This detail led me to re-examine all of the surviving primary sources, including the Journals of the Continental Congress and letters from John Adams. Through this, I conclude that it is possible to achieve much greater certainty about the probable time for the Declaration.

In this four-hour video essay, I present a series of compelling arguments that the birth chart for the US should be set for the late morning of July 4, 1776, giving the country a Libra Ascendant.

*Key topics covered in this episode:*

🪐 *The Astrological Signatures of 1776:* A look at how the Mars-Uranus conjunction in Gemini represented the severance and armed rebellion against Great Britain, while the highly auspicious Venus-Jupiter conjunction in Cancer symbolized the union of the thirteen colonies.

🪐 *Jefferson's Weather Log:* How Thomas Jefferson's daily temperature readings help establish a clear timeline of when Congress was in session and taking breaks.

🪐 *Debunking the Sibley Chart:* An explanation of the critical misunderstanding behind the popular Sagittarius rising chart. I show how Ebenezer Sibley actually cast a mundane ingress chart for London rather than a timed natal chart for Philadelphia.

🪐 *The Gemini Rising Myth:* Why a 2:00 AM or 3:00 AM chart is historically implausible and makes for a poor electional chart.

🪐 *Historical Transits:* A preliminary look at how major events in US history, such as the Civil War, the Apollo 11 moon landing, and the stock market crash of 1929, and Martin Luther King's "I Have a Dream" speech align remarkably well with a Libra rising chart.

This episode outlines all of my research findings in one place to help advance the long-standing debate over the true astrological chart of the United States.

This is episode 543 of The Astrology Podcast.
